'''Nick''' was a seller of various types of [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. Signs advertising Nick's speeders could be seen throughout the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]].
